posts.title: CRF CALENDAR APPLICATION
posts.summary: Interactive CRF event calendar connected to remote event data through a PHP/JSON integration.
posts.skills:
Front End Development
JavaScript
jQuery
PHP
JSON / API Integration
Bootstrap
Responsive Web Development
Calendar UI
posts.content:
CRF Calendar was an interactive event-calendar application developed for the Cardiovascular Research Foundation.

The front end requested calendar data by date range, transformed the returned JSON into calendar entries, supported month and year navigation, and assembled event-detail modal content dynamically with JavaScript and jQuery.

A PHP endpoint used cURL to request public calendar-event data from CRF/TCTMD and returned that response to the browser, separating the remote service request from the client-side calendar interface.

posts.title: ADVANCES IN HEMODYNAMIC SUPPORT 2015
posts.summary: Responsive medical-education event website for the 2015 Advances in Hemodynamic Support program.
posts.content:
Advances in Hemodynamic Support was a CRF medical-education program held January 29–30, 2015 and supported through an educational grant from ABIOMED.

Developed the responsive event website as a single-page conference experience using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and the Foundation responsive framework.

The surviving source and screenshots document the program information, responsive navigation and event-focused presentation across the site.

posts.content:
New Frontiers in Cardiovascular Medicine: The Next Decade was a CRF educational satellite program connected with SCAI 2016.

Developed the responsive site in a PHP include/template structure with Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery and Sass/SCSS source styles.

The front end used Flexslider and custom slider-animation JavaScript for the event presentation, with responsive program, registration and supporting content assembled through reusable PHP includes.
